entries.rationale: axe cannot confirm this element: it carries aria-label (or aria-labelledby) but has no role that permits naming (noRoleSingular), so assistive technology may ignore the label. A real defect, not an axe limitation: give the region an explicit role or drop the label at the component that renders it.

Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce this element keeps a transition longer than 1ms. The reduced-motion token block in theme.css is scoped to html.accrue-admin, and the Storybook sandbox puts accrue-admin on .psb-sandbox instead, so sandbox elements keep default durations. The mounted admin shell is not affected (reduced-motion.spec.js). 2.3.3 is an AAA project target. Fix at the token tier by also matching .psb-sandbox.accrue-admin.

Every row repeats a link whose accessible name is only the visible label, so rows cannot be told apart by name. The name should include the row identity (customer label) while the visible label stays the start of the name (2.5.3). Fix at the copy and component tier.

At 200% text size (browser font-size setting, verified at 2.00x) the page content no longer fits its layout boundary, so the existing geometry check reports an overflow. Fix at the group or page tier, or record a narrower accepted exception with evidence.

With WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing applied (line height 1.5, letter spacing 0.12em, word spacing 0.16em) text inside the drawer panel is clipped by its overflow boundary. Fix at the overlay component.

The drawer body scrolls but is neither focusable nor contains a focusable element, so a keyboard user cannot scroll it. Fix at the drawer component: make the scroll region focusable with a role and an accessible name.

axe target-size (WCAG 2.5.8) reports an undersized link whose 24px spacing circle meets another target, in the table and constrained-content layouts of one_row. Fix at the component tier (target padding or spacing).

After Escape closes the guarded-action drawer, keyboard focus lands on main#main-content instead of the Cancel immediately trigger or the More actions button that owns it. Escape is handled twice: the drawer's focus trap dismisses it, and dropdown.js closes the open action menu and refocuses its button; the drawer's restore then runs two animation frames later, cannot restore the now-hidden item and falls back to the page. Fix at the component tier so one owner decides the return target (DetailDrawer does not forward the overlay's focus_return_to). This entry is evaluated by the D-29 keyboard journey in admin-interactions.spec.js, not by the composition cells; once the defect is fixed the journey fails until the entry is deleted.

After Back to subscription closes the guarded-action drawer, keyboard focus lands on main#main-content instead of the Cancel immediately trigger. Evidence from the mounted route: the trigger node is unchanged, still connected and the action menu still open when the drawer closes, so the Overlay hook did not hold it as the element to restore and fell back to the page. DetailDrawer does not forward the overlay's focus_return_to; fix at the component tier by giving the drawer a stable return target. This entry is evaluated by the D-29 keyboard journey in admin-interactions.spec.js, not by the composition cells; once the defect is fixed the journey fails until the entry is deleted.
